meta.title: Vendor e-mail when a counter offer is sent
gaps: Open each concerned QA vendor mailbox and verify exactly one counter-offer email with an accept/reject link, no email to other vendors, and no email to a real supplier.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open each concerned QA vendor mailbox and verify exactly one counter-offer email with an accept/reject link, no email to other vendors, and no email to a real supplier.

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the counter-offer setup.
Create an RFQ stage, which is the pricing stage needed for a vendor counter offer.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a line item so the vendor can submit a quote.
Commit a valid event schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA vendor to receive and respond to the event.
Publish the event so the vendor can bid.
Verify the event reached a real published project page.
Have the invited vendor submit a bid, which is required before sending a counter offer.
Verify the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer comparison grid where the counter offer can be initiated.
Send the buyer's counter offer to the vendor.
Verify the buyer grid marks the counter offer as initiated.

args.need: open each concerned QA vendor mailbox and verify the counter-offer email, its accept/reject link, recipient exclusivity, and absence of mail to real suppliers

steps.note: Mailbox access and delivery-recipient verification are not available in the catalog.
If the tester leaves the relevant mailbox open, check that the counter-offer email content is visible.
Check for the expected acceptance link or control in the email.
Check for the expected rejection link or control in the email.
